subject.title: feat(telegram): send voice typing cue before transcription

question: Should this Telegram transport-visible PR wait for redacted live Telegram proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the source-ordering tests as sufficient for this short typing cue?
rationale: The patch looks directionally correct in source, but Telegram-visible chat-action behavior can be too brief or delayed to trust from mocks alone, and the scoped Telegram policy asks for real Telegram proof for transport-visible changes.

options.title: Require live Telegram proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a contributor or maintainer proof lane adds redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-log, live output, or equivalent evidence showing the cue before transcription or before the agent reply.

options.title: Accept source-ordering risk
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally merge based on the bounded source-ordering tests, while owning the risk that the cue is not visible soon enough in a real Telegram client.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the PR paired with the canonical issue until credentials or a proof lane can demonstrate the visible behavior.

recommendation.title: Require live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a contributor or maintainer proof lane adds redacted Telegram Desktop, bot-log, live output, or equivalent evidence showing the cue before transcription or before the agent reply.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current routing signal is recent Telegram context/body ownership around the same message-context boundary and proof-sensitive channel behavior.
